categories.name: Keep
categories.hint: Single clearly-presented product, clean/seamless background, sharp, well-lit, accurate colour, no distracting watermark. OVR_Quality_Score >= 60

categories.name: Lifestyle
categories.hint: Product shown in-context / lifestyle scene — useful but a different bucket from clean packshots

categories.name: Borderline
categories.hint: Product but cluttered background, soft focus, poor/uneven lighting, distracting reflections, or a minor watermark -> human review

categories.name: OffTopic
categories.hint: No clear product, or unrelated to the catalogue subject

preset.category_rules:
STRICT JUDGEMENT RULES (no exceptions):
- Fill `description` and `primary_subject` FIRST, from the pixels only. Then make every label agree with that description.
- art_medium = `photograph` ONLY for a camera-captured (or AI photoreal) image; a render/illustration is the matching label, never `photograph`.
- has_ai_flaws = TRUE only for SEVERE artefacts (melted product geometry, warped logos/text, impossible reflections).
- A SCREENSHOT is the WHOLE frame being a screen capture (UI chrome). A photo that merely contains a screen as a scene object is NOT a screenshot.
- A COMPOSITE/GRID is 2+ separate images stitched together -> is_composite_grid=true and DISCARD.
- contains_text_overlay = TRUE for burned-in promo text, price tags, captions, logos or watermarks.
- nsfw = TRUE only for explicit nudity or sexual content.
Product / e-commerce dataset. Reward a single clearly-presented product, even studio lighting, a seamless or clean background and accurate colour. A product shown within a real-world/lifestyle scene goes to Lifestyle. Penalise busy/cluttered backgrounds, distracting reflections, and burned-in promotional text or watermarks (contains_text_overlay=true -> Borderline at best; DISCARD if the overlay dominates). The curation topic only informs REL_Quality_Score.

scoring.notes: Reward clean/seamless backgrounds, even lighting, sharpness and accurate colour. Penalise clutter, distracting reflections and burned-in promo text/watermarks.
